scoring_justification: Recompute average formation energies from per-site data in CSV for crystalline (distance < -5 Å) and amorphous (distance > 5 Å) regions, compare to paper's reported gold values with appropriate tolerance, and verify trend crystalline > amorphous.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold average formation energies for crystalline and amorphous regions
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: crystalline average 2.6 eV, amorphous average 0.2 eV (Sect. 2, Fig. 2)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported numbers, used only as hidden reference for scoring tolerance

outputs.description: CSV with one row per oxygen vacancy site. The checker will filter by distance (crystalline: < -5 Å; amorphous: > 5 Å) to compute average formation energies and verify the trend.

output_contract.notes: The averages are recomputed by the checker from the raw data; no gold values are provided here. The trend (crystalline average > amorphous average) is also verified.
